title: Vehicular Homicide (Death by Auto or Vessel)
grade_or_penalty: 2nd degree; 1st degree with aggravators such as DWI in a school zone or crossing, or driving while suspended for DWI
key_points: Recklessly driving a vehicle or vessel and causing death.
Driving after more than 24 hours without sleep, or while DWI, permits an inference of recklessness.
DWI-based convictions carry mandatory parole ineligibility.
elements: The suspect was driving a vehicle or operating a vessel
The reckless driving caused the victim's death
